title: Pokémon
description: Gotta know 'em all! Test your Pokémon knowledge!

questions.question: Who is Ash Ketchum's first and most iconic Pokémon?
questions.explanation: Ash received Pikachu from Professor Oak after sleeping through his start time.

questions.question: What region is featured in Pokémon Red and Blue?
questions.explanation: Pokémon Red and Blue take place in the Kanto region, home to the original 151 Pokémon.

questions.question: Mewtwo was created in a lab from the DNA of Mew.
questions.explanation: Mewtwo is a genetically engineered clone of Mew created by Team Rocket scientists.

questions.question: How many Pokémon types are there in the current games?
questions.explanation: There are 18 types including Fairy, which was added in Generation 6.

questions.question: Which Pokémon is known as the Genetic Pokémon?
questions.explanation: Mewtwo is classified as the Genetic Pokémon due to its lab origins.

questions.question: Charizard is a Fire/Dragon type Pokémon.
questions.explanation: Charizard is actually a Fire/Flying type, not Dragon, despite looking like one.

questions.question: Which of these Pokémon evolves using a Water Stone?
questions.explanation: Eevee evolves into Vaporeon when exposed to a Water Stone.

questions.question: What is Professor Oak's first name?
questions.explanation: Professor Oak's first name is Samuel, and he resides in Pallet Town.

questions.question: Which legendary trio is associated with the Johto region?
questions.explanation: Raikou, Entei, and Suicune are the legendary beasts of Johto, awakened by Ho-Oh.

questions.question: Magikarp evolves into Gyarados at level 20.
questions.explanation: Despite being weak, Magikarp evolves into the fearsome Gyarados at level 20.
